                (blockEntity, side) -> blockEntity);

comment_corrections: GT6's tile entity checks the block it faces every tick: if that neighbour is a tree hole with * resin, it extracts the resin, fills its 8000 mB tank with the sap fluid and puts the resin item * into its single slot (the rubber hole yields an item instead of a fluid). Right-clicking hands out

This port checks the facing tree hole every server tick, keeping an 8000 mB tank and one item * slot. Registered holes select one yield kind here; the original rubber hole provides both an * item and a fluid. Right-clicking hands out
IFluidHandler (GT6's bag is a plain tank, so pipes can drain it)
Port IFluidHandler extension (original public tank lookup does not expose the bag tank)
/** True when the bag holds anything (GT6's {@code mFull}, used for its full overlay). */
/** GT6's {@code mFull} condition; the current block model does not consume this value. */

* Right-clicking a filled hole hands out the resin item (rubber) or fills the held container with
 * the sap fluid (maple/rainbowood); breaking it drops the log it was cut into.

* This port's right-click branch selects the resin item (rubber) or sap fluid (maple/rainbowood);
 * the original rubber hole can provide both. Breaking a hole drops its source log.
Every 600 ticks (30 s) a still-empty hole walks up its own trunk, counts the leaves of the tree * at the exact positions GT6 lists for that species, and rolls
Every 600 ticks spent empty, the port walks up its native species trunk, counts its leaves * at the species canopy positions, and rolls
